name: Skinner v4.0.1 — Sleek Studio UI, Authentic KO Effects, Instant Navigation & Polished Presets
changelog: Sleek Settings-Style Preset Dropdown: Clean, compact slot selector replacing crowded button pills.
Dedicated In-App Slot Rename Modal: Elegant dark-glass dialog replacing system browser prompts.
Full-Fidelity Authentic KO Effects: Restored complete composite SVG rendering with crisp visuals for all 49 knockout effects.
Fixed Sidebar & Scrollbar Layout: Beautiful vertical dock sidebar on the left and smooth full-height scrolling.
Instant Zero-Lag Tab Switching: Keep-alive DOM preservation eliminates frame drops between Legends and KO Effects.
Smooth Window Dragging on Startup: Balanced asset batch chunking and UI thread yielding prevents window drag stutter.
Ed25519 Cryptographic Verification: All binaries signed and secured with SHA-256 integrity checks.
